--- a/DIAGNOSIS.json
+++ b/DIAGNOSIS.json
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+{
+  "candidate": "cand_0001",
+  "headline": "Create initial airline capability: add find_reservations + get_price_quote read tools, in-body cancel-flown guard, enriched booking error + update-tool returns, and policy rules for reservation resolution / execute-after-confirm / authoritative pricing.",
+  "clusters": [
+    {"id": "A", "name": "Wrong-reservation targeting",
+     "detail": "User describes a trip with no reservation id; agent grabs the first id from get_user_details and operates on the wrong reservation, so every downstream write diverges from gold. No tool existed to list/match a user's reservations by route.",
+     "tasks": ["17", "22"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
+    {"id": "B", "name": "Guessed/stale booking payment total",
+     "detail": "Agent builds the book_reservation payment split from prices stored on an existing reservation (stale) rather than current flight prices; book_reservation raises 'Payment amount does not add up' and writes nothing, and the opaque error strands the agent.",
+     "tasks": ["25", "23"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
+    {"id": "C", "name": "Mental fare/refund math",
+     "detail": "Agent computes charge/refund by hand, reports the wrong amount (fails the COMMUNICATE check in task 11) and sometimes drives a wrong follow-up write off the bad number. The update tools already compute the exact delta but discarded it.",
+     "tasks": ["11", "37"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
+    {"id": "D", "name": "Unauthorized cancel of a flown reservation",
+     "detail": "Agent cancelled a reservation whose segments had already flown (policy forbids; the API does not enforce it), corrupting the DB.",
+     "tasks": ["37"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
+    {"id": "E", "name": "Narrate-without-action / bail-out after confirm or error",
+     "detail": "After the user confirms, agent reports the change as done or transfers without issuing the write; after a write error it abandons rather than correcting and retrying.",
+     "tasks": ["12", "37", "23", "25"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"}
+  ],
+  "edits": [
+    {"id": "E1", "title": "Add find_reservations read tool (list + route/date/flight filters)",
+     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "CAPABILITY-GAP", "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
+     "verified": "Additive read tool; filter matches a reservation on trip origin/dest OR any segment. Returns FQ8APE's summary for an NYC->ORD query, so the agent stops operating on the first id."},
+    {"id": "E2", "title": "Add get_price_quote read tool (authoritative total from current prices)",
+     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "CAPABILITY-GAP", "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
+     "verified": "Reuses book_reservation pricing; returns total=375 for task-25 legs so the first booking split is correct."},
+    {"id": "E3", "title": "Enrich book_reservation payment/not-found errors with breakdown + next step",
+     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["B", "E"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
+     "verified": "On task-25 bad split prints total 375 (flights 375+baggage 0+insurance 0), paid 299, short 76, resubmit to 375. Only error text changes; passing calls never reach it."},
+    {"id": "E4", "title": "cancel_reservation flown/already-cancelled in-body guard",
+     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
+     "verified": "Blocks 37-t2 NQNU5R (segments 2024-05-13/14 < today 2024-05-15); allows 19-t1 Z7GOZK and 23-t1 K1NW8N (future segments). Confirmed against the real reservation data in the passing trials."},
+    {"id": "E5", "title": "Return payment_delta/amount_charged/amount_refunded from update tools",
+     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
+     "verified": "DB mutation happens in place before the return, so DB grading is unchanged; the dict superset exposes the engine's exact amount the COMMUNICATE check for task 11 wants."},
+    {"id": "E6", "title": "Policy: reservation-resolution rule + find_reservations worked example",
+     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
+     "verified": "Reinforces existing 'locate it using available tools'; adds an imperative + example, flips no decision."},
+    {"id": "E7", "title": "Policy: execute-immediately-after-confirmation + recover-from-write-error contract",
+     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "CONTRACT", "clusters": ["E"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
+     "verified": "Tightening with WRONG/RIGHT worked examples; no passing task relied on narrating without acting."},
+    {"id": "E8", "title": "Policy: authoritative pricing + quote-the-returned-amount rules",
+     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["B", "C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
+     "verified": "Points the agent at get_price_quote before booking and at payment_delta for charge/refund reporting; additive guidance with a worked split example."}
+  ],
+  "skipped": [
+    {"title": "Task 40", "reason": "Documented tau2 user-simulator infra noise; instructed not to optimize against it."},
+    {"title": "book_reservation baggage-allowance auto-compute (membership x cabin)", "reason": "No failing trial miscomputed bags (all 0/0); a guard there is speculative and unsupported by the traces."},
+    {"title": "Composite confirm->write tool for the narrate-without-action stall", "reason": "The stall is ending the turn / transferring, which a composite cannot force; used the prose contract this iteration. Switch to a composite WRITE if cluster E persists."}
+  ],
+  "techniques": ["parallel diagnostic subagents per cluster", "new read tools for capability gaps", "in-body eligibility guard verified against passing traces", "enriched actionable error text", "enriched return values surfacing engine-computed amounts", "policy worked examples for a mid-tier reader"]
+}
--- a/policy/policy.md
+++ b/policy/policy.md
@@ -6,4 +6,10 @@
 
 Before taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.
+
+**Execute immediately after confirmation.** The moment the user confirms (says "yes" or approves), your VERY NEXT action MUST be the matching write tool call (`book_reservation`, `update_reservation_flights`, `update_reservation_baggages`, `update_reservation_passengers`, or `cancel_reservation`). Do NOT describe the change as "done", "processed", or "completed" until the write tool has actually returned a reservation object. Do NOT transfer, summarize again, or end the turn before issuing the write.
+- WRONG: user says "yes", and you reply "Your upgrade is complete!" without any tool call. The database is unchanged and the task fails.
+- RIGHT: user says "yes", and your next step is the `update_reservation_flights` tool call; only after it returns do you tell the user it is done, quoting the amount from the tool's return.
+
+**Recover from a write error, do not abandon it.** If a write tool raises an error (for example "Payment amount does not add up"), read the error, correct the arguments it names, and immediately re-issue the corrected write call. Never report the change as done, and never give up or transfer, just because the first call errored — the error text tells you exactly what to fix.
 
 You should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.
